document.title: Ethereon Mode Protocol
purpose: Introduce Observation mode for architectural inspection
Strengthen promotion validation with conceptual layer checks
Extend continuity index with conceptual recurrence metrics

Observation.description: Analytical inspection mode used for reviewing architecture, artifacts, and conceptual coherence without mutation.

conceptual_layer_check_confirmation.description: Validation that architectural changes do not create dependency between symbolic narrative layers and structural system architecture.
conceptual_layer_check_confirmation.validation_rule: Architecture must remain functional independent of symbolic or narrative constructs.

canon_lineage_schema.description: Tracks canonical architecture evolution while preserving immutability of prior canonical states.
rules: Canon states remain immutable once promoted.
Each canon_version must reference exactly one parent except root.
Lineage must form an append-only chain.

conceptual_recurrence.description: Measures recurrence of core conceptual frameworks across sessions without explicit prompt injection.
conceptual_recurrence.purpose: Evaluate whether intellectual identity patterns persist across system resets or architectural changes.

governance_notes: Observation mode does not permit architectural mutation.
Observation mode is intended for audits, inspections, and meta-analysis.
Conceptual layer checks enforce separation between narrative symbolism and system architecture.
Canon lineage tracking ensures structural history remains auditable.
Status aligned with runtime implementation on 2026-04-04.
Runtime implementations may accept historical alias fields for promotion artifacts, but canonical documentation should use conceptual_layer_check_confirmation.
Status aligned with merged runtime seed and live sea-trial implementation on 2026-04-04.

v1.1 and v1.2 remain foundational history and should not be treated as current live law.
